facts.fact: Tunisie Numerique, citing the World Bank, says 37% of Tunisians held a financial account in 2024, 29% of women and 32% of low-income people.

Tunisie Numerique, citing Central Bank data for the first half of 2025, says Tunisia had 371,000 e-wallets across 16 authorised mobile service providers, used for transfers, payments and cash withdrawals.
